title: No and erroneous basal rate shown
body:
I'm changing my G6. During the 2h warmup, I stop the loop to have the DASH deliver the basal rate.

On the screen, I just a trait with no rate; if I hit the small line, it says 0.48U/h but the DASH tab says 0.50U/h...

I'd like to see the real rate shown on the main UI.

![Screenshot_20220331-190440_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161127822-f0274fbe-c993-4079-aa7b-66e98de49efa.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220331-204240_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161127857-16c81e33-3bce-440e-8605-b2c3fafc451d.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220331-204256_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161127883-094397fd-d0be-420a-a973-e2d0c7fe84d7.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220331-204306_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161127893-d4194f58-6157-40af-8294-ce9ea7b6ed25.jpg)

comments.body:
There is no basal curve on rhe graph for almost 2h either...

![Screenshot_20220331-222505_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161143950-8ed1a507-a13b-4cb7-95b0-27ac86c8df8c.jpg)

I've seen the wrong basal curve on the graph as well. Sometimes it takes a status refresh (regular pump history refresh) to finally refresh the graph as well and show the correct basal rate.

What I've also noticed and which is visible in your screenshot of the pump tab (DASH) as well is that the temporal basal rate is missing although there is currently a TBR running.

Let me know if you need additional logs.

My system:
AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1 479bfc410
Android 11 (LineageOS)
Medtronic 523
Dexcom G6 with BYODA
Not for me. I've never see it happen again. You can close this issue.
